answer: Ledge cipher-chain bond: each identity claims a ledge, locking 70 credits. Each epoch a beacon posts a pulse. The holder files a signed cipher link hashing the pulse and its prior link. Auditors replay the chain; a missing link, a reused cipher, or a shared chain burns the bond. First 35, kth 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000, lock 70,000, vs 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail: one chain per ledge. Honest agents pay 35 once and keep the bond.
